}}'''Jair''' is an [[Aiel]] woman of the [[Daryne]] clan.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Jair}}

==History==
She is the wife of [[Mandelain]] and [[sister-wife]] to [[Corehuin]]. She is [[Roofmistress]] of the [[Jahad Hold]] of the [[Broken Cliff]] sept of the Daryn Aiel.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Mandelain}}

==Actions==
She stayed in her Hold when Mandelain left the [[Aiel Waste]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Corehuin}}
